items.title: Trump-linked crypto token WLFI plunges 50% to record lows
items.snippet: As prices tanked, blockchain trackers flagged a large outflow of ether from a wallet linked to World Liberty Financial.
items.note: Негативний тон для ETH за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Binance receives in-principle approval, plans Asia hub in Bhutan
items.snippet: The agreement is a milestone in Binance’s effort to expand its presence in Bhutan since launching a national crypto-powered tourism payment system in 2025.
items.note: Позитивний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами.
